description: Unified benchmark configuration for 13 NASTRAN-95 refactoring experiments

benchmarks.name: CROD
benchmarks.description: Rod element (axial + torsion), 2 nodes, 3 DOF/node, 6x6 stiffness matrix
benchmarks._oracle_note: Reference produced by compiling and running the original NASTRAN-95 kernel via the standalone driver in source_fortran/test_drivers/b1_krod/. Replaced an analytical Python formula on 2026-08-21.
benchmarks.compared_dof_note: only the translational DOF of both nodes are compared (rows/cols 1-3 of each node); the torsional GJ/L block is present in the reference but excluded by the comparison

benchmarks.name: CBAR
benchmarks.description: Beam element (bending + torsion + axial), 2 nodes, 6 DOF/node, 12x12 stiffness matrix
benchmarks._oracle_note: Reference produced by compiling and running the original NASTRAN-95 kernel via the standalone driver in source_fortran/test_drivers/b2_kbar/. Replaced an analytical Python formula on 2026-08-21.

benchmarks.name: CTRIA3
benchmarks.description: Triangular membrane (CST), 3 nodes, 2 DOF/node, 6x6 stiffness matrix
benchmarks._oracle_note: Reference produced by compiling and running the original NASTRAN-95 kernel via the standalone driver in source_fortran/test_drivers/b3_ktrmem/. Replaced an analytical Python formula on 2026-08-21.
benchmarks.compared_dof_note: in-plane membrane block; the out-of-plane DOF that SMA1B writes are dropped

benchmarks.name: CQUAD4
benchmarks.description: Quad membrane, 4 nodes, 2 DOF/node, 8x8 stiffness matrix
benchmarks._oracle_note: Reference produced by compiling and running the original NASTRAN-95 kernel via the standalone driver in source_fortran/test_drivers/b4_ktriqd/. Replaced an analytical Python formula on 2026-08-21.
benchmarks._prompt_note: ktriqd.f replaced by ktrmem.f on 2026-08-21: kqdmem.f calls KTRMEM, not KTRIQD. Description no longer asserts a decomposition; the old text said '2-triangle' while the kernel uses four overlapping corner triangles at half thickness, which instructed the model to produce the answer the oracle rejects.
benchmarks.compared_dof_note: in-plane membrane block; the out-of-plane DOF that SMA1B writes are dropped
benchmarks._callee_source_note: Callee source OMITTED, matching B1/B2/B3 which are not given GMMATD either. ktrmem.f is numerically the textbook CST (verified 4.65e-08 against it), so it adds 406 lines of redundant content while diluting the assembly conventions in kqdmem.f that actually decide correctness: the four-triangle DATA M map, ECPT(8)/2.0, and the JNOT per-pivot skip.

benchmarks.name: TRD1C
benchmarks.description: Transient response by direct integration (central difference), timeseries output

output_contract.layout: one row per sampled step, 3 displacement values per row, no time or step column

benchmarks.contract_note: Implicit-convention benchmark. The legacy formulation discards the applied load at t=0 and substitutes an effective load K*u0 (form1.f, ISTART<0), then averages the load over three consecutive time levels (trd1c.f label 100). The first step therefore advances by dt^2/3, not the textbook dt^2/2. Measured residuals: legacy convention 1.3e-4, textbook start-up 1.96e-3, literal form1.f 8.33e-3. Tolerance 1e-3 admits only the first. The convention is intentionally NOT disclosed in the prompt.

benchmarks.name: SROD1
benchmarks.description: Rod element stress recovery from displacement, scalar stress/force output

benchmarks.name: KTRBSC
benchmarks.description: Triangular plate bending sub-module (basic stiffness), 3 nodes, 3 DOF/node, 9x9 stiffness matrix
benchmarks._note: Sub-module of B5 KTRPLT. Tests KTRBSC in isolation. If agent passes this, the verified code is used as a building block for the full B5 assembly (KTRPLT).
